## Contract / decision

Link the ADR, source version and validation gate.

## Changes

Describe ownership, transaction, schema and compatibility effects.

## Evidence

- [ ] Mirrored tests added/updated
- [ ] Bun and Node impact assessed
- [ ] Effect diagnostics/typecheck/format/lint
- [ ] Failure/rollback/replay behavior assessed
- [ ] No credentials or unapproved provisioning
- [ ] Docs and public exports updated

Scaffold tests do not count as runtime durability evidence.
